basic_profile.bio: I'm a curious soul from Little Rock, Arkansas, navigating my way through the vast world of Reddit. I'm a big fan of 3D printing and recently got my hands on an Anycubic Photon Mono, which has been a game-changer for my hobby projects. When I'm not tinkering with my printer, I'm exploring spiritual teachings, particularly those of Ram Dass. I work as a junior graphic designer and enjoy spending my evenings learning new design techniques or catching up on the latest Razorbacks games. I'm currently single, which gives me plenty of time to indulge in my interests. I typically hop onto Reddit during my lunch breaks and late at night when I'm winding down for the day.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied it in college and now working in the field. My interest in spirituality and personal development is mostly self-taught, driven by hours of listening to lectures and reading related literature. My passion for 3D printing has been a recent development, sparked by online communities and trial and error with my own projects.
